evidence.note: MTLD3D12Device::CheckFeatureSupport is the current runtime implementation.
Phase 4 will prove these reports without launching a game.

proven_subset: D3D12_LOGIC_OP_XOR render-target execution and exact readback
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.risk: Output-merger logic operations are backed by a focused XOR render/readback proof for render target 0 only; independent per-render-target logic-operation state remains rejected, while conservative rasterization and broader options remain gated.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS1.risk: WaveOps reporting must remain coupled to the 32-lane dispatch/readback corpus.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS3_WRITE_BUFFE.risk: Copy-queue timestamps are coalesced to the Metal command buffer GPU end time and resolved through a completion handler; write-immediate flags are coupled to exact default, marker-in, and marker-out GPU virtual-address readback coverage on direct, compute, and inlined bundle command lists.

D3D12_METAL_RAYTRACING_HARDWARE.risk: Metal hardware support is only a prerequisite; DXR tier must remain unreported until acceleration structures, state objects, shader tables, synchronization, and DispatchRays pass behavior gates.

D3D12_DXR_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURES.risk: A twelve-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS, one-AABB BLAS, behavior-proven BLAS clone, shifted triangle/AABB/TLAS refits, compacted-size query, traversed compact copy, process-scoped BLAS/TLAS serialization and deserialization through a copied opaque blob, a twelve-instance TLAS with exact serialized pointer list, source-resource release before deserialized-TLAS traversal, mask-isolated inline RayQuery hit, stable distinct export identifiers with the Metal Shader Converter local-sampler slot preserved at bytes 16-23 and private alias hashes isolated to bytes 24-31, filtered same-table multi-collection merging with renamed imports and invalid-export rejection, direct and indirect DispatchRays execution, executed base/grown hit-group records with associated local-root constant and mirrored SRV/UAV/CBV/sampler tables, renamed and indexed miss/callable table records, raygen/triangle-any-hit/closest-hit/procedural-intersection records, depth-2 recursive TraceRay, deterministic shader stack-size values, and configured pipeline stack-size retention prove foundational DXR execution; mixed triangle/AABB geometry within one BLAS, persistent cross-process serialized reconstruction, independently linked collection merging, new-library state-object growth and broader record-count/stride/local-data shader-table matrices remain gated.

proven_subset: RSSetShadingRate 2x2 command recording with MAX/PASSTHROUGH combiners
Metal rasterization-rate map creation and render-pass attachment

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS6.risk: The per-draw 1x2/2x1/2x2/2x4/4x2/4x4 paths record D3D12 shading-rate commands and attach Metal rasterization-rate maps, reducing the focused 64x64 readback to 2112/2112/1089/1056/1056/1024 nonzero pixels; the 2x2 case also passes a MAX/PASSTHROUGH combiner pair. A copied constant R8_UINT 8x8 shading-rate image uses the D3D12 PASSTHROUGH/OVERRIDE pair, independently-axis SUM/SUM, and produces the expected 1089-pixel 2x2 result. A nonconstant 8x8 checkerboard image is now emulated as 64 scoped load/store render passes with exact 2320-pixel readback for both non-indexed and indexed draws. Logical-resolution reconstruction, actual per-primitive rate selection, broader combiner matrices, and full Tier-2 breadth remain unproven, so Options6 stays conservative. SV_ShadingRate vertex-to-pixel semantic transport is covered, but it does not by itself change Metal's rasterization rate. AdditionalShadingRatesSupported is reported independently because the focused 2x4/4x2/4x4 matrix passes.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7.risk: Sampler feedback uses padded software maps with SIMD-cooperative locking. Committed and placed resources, invalid-descriptor rejection, feedback UAV pairing, clear, min-mip and mip-region-used writes, 2D arrays, encode/decode resolves, contention, and all four HLSL write forms pass exact compute/pixel readback; tier 0.9 is reported because wrap and clamp are conservatively covered while unrestricted tier-1.0 SRV/addressing behavior remains gated. Mesh AS/MS execution is substantial and PIPELINE_STATISTICS1 invocation/primitive accounting passes the focused two-group dispatch, but mixed render-state breadth and broader shader/payload coverage remain insufficient for mesh tier 1.

proven_subset: constant-image SUM/SUM independent-axis combination with exact 2x2 readback
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS10.risk: VariableRateShadingSumCombinerSupported is backed by the constant-image SUM/SUM readback and the axis-wise saturation implementation. MeshShaderPerPrimitiveShadingRateSupported remains false until SV_ShadingRate output is translated and exercised in a mesh pipeline.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS11.risk: ResourceDescriptorHeap atomic64 uses the same software lock lowering as raw and typed resources. A directly-indexed heap add stress and add/and/or/xor/min/max/exchange/compare-exchange matrix pass exact readback; direct heap descriptors are rebound after ordinary root tables so heap indices retain D3D12 meaning.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS12.risk: Enhanced barriers close active Metal encoders and establish queue order through the command-queue shared event. The report is backed by global, buffer, and texture groups plus exact copy-destination to copy-source buffer readback. Relaxed casting is limited to explicitly declared Device10 castable formats and is backed by committed/placed R32_FLOAT-to-R32_UINT readback, a focused overlapping placed-resource alias switch from 1.0 to 2.0, cross-layout R8G8B8A8_UINT readback, mismatched-unit-size creation rejection, and rejection of an undeclared R32_SINT view.

compute-stage uint32 GatherRaw through a declared castable format
compute-stage SampleCmpLevel with explicit LOD 0/1
depth SRV comparison sampling and DSV mip clear selection
compute-stage writable MSAA texture creation and UAV binding
compute-stage per-sample TextureStoreSample and TextureLoad readback
compute-stage writable RWTexture2DMSArray sample and array-slice readback
graphics-stage writable MSAA UAV store for 2D and array resources with a DSV
compute and graphics sample counts 2, 4, and 8
R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, and R8G8B8A8_UNORM sample resolves
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS14.risk: Exact compute and graphics readbacks prove the three advanced texture operation families and a focused writable-MSAA subset covering 2D and 2D-array resources, including a DSV-attached graphics pass, sample counts 2/4/8, and full-sample-count float resolves for R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, and R8G8B8A8_UNORM. DXMT emulates writable UAV MSAA resources as private 2D-array slices with logical array slices expanded by the sample count, but both Options14 capability fields remain conservative until additional formats, render-target, and broader resolve matrices pass.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS8.risk: The support report is backed by creation and upload/readback of a 7x5 BC1 texture with exact two-row block payload validation.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS9.risk: Native Metal atomic_ulong remains insufficient. DXMT serializes 64-bit atomic critical sections through 32-bit Metal locks, uses SIMD-cooperative lane selection to avoid same-SIMD spinlock deadlock, and proves 64-thread add stress plus unsigned/signed operation and compare-exchange matrices for typed resources and group-shared memory.

D3D12_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_2_TARGET.risk: Raising the central maximum before every FL12_2 behavior gate passes would recreate false-success device creation.

D3D12_FEATURE_FEATURE_LEVELS.risk: UE5 may reject the adapter if this disagrees with shader model or options queries.

D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL.risk: SM 6.7 is behavior-backed by the SM 6.6 root-constant, descriptor-indexing, 64-bit, atomic/barrier, and texture/sampler runtime corpus plus SM 6.7 QuadAny/QuadAll dispatch/readback. Compute-stage programmable offsets, GatherRaw, and SampleCmpLevel now pass as a separate Options14 subset, while graphics-stage breadth and writable MSAA remain gated.

D3D12_SYNTHETIC_SHADER_CORPUS.risk: Game captures must remain diagnostic; shader support claims require synthetic corpus coverage.

purpose: Keep D3D12 feature reports aligned with executable implementation reality.
